name: Peri3dController
description: Class for controlling independently all 6 components of "engineering" stress<Peri3dController.stress> and strain<Peri3dController.strain> of periodic Cell. goal<Peri3dController.goal> are the goal values, while stressMask<Peri3dController.stressMask> determines which components prescribe stress and...

attributes.name: stress
attributes.description: Current stress vector ($ sigma_x$,$ sigma_y$,$ sigma_z$,$ tau_{yz}$,$ tau_{zx}$,$ tau_{xy}$)(auto-updated).

attributes.name: strain
attributes.description: Current strain (deformation) vector ($ varepsilon_x$,$ varepsilon_y$,$ varepsilon_z$,$ gamma_{yz}$,$ gamma_{zx}$,$ gamma_{xy}$) (auto-updated).

attributes.name: strainRate
attributes.description: Current strain rate vector.

attributes.name: stressRate
attributes.description: Current stress rate vector (that is prescribed, the actual one slightly differ).

attributes.name: stressIdeal
attributes.description: Ideal stress vector at current time step.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: Goal state; only the upper triangular matrix is considered; each component is either prescribed stress or strain, depending on

attributes.name: stressMask
attributes.description: mask determining whether components of goal are strain (0) or stress (1). The order is 00,11,22,12,02,01 from the least significant bit. (e.g. 0b000011 is stress 00 and stress 11).

attributes.name: nSteps
attributes.description: Number of steps of the simulation.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: Actual progress of the simulation with Controller.

attributes.name: mod
attributes.description: Predictor modificator, by trail-and-error analysis the value 0.1 was found as the best.

attributes.name: doneHook
attributes.description: Python command (as string) to run when nSteps is achieved. If empty, the engine will be set dead.

attributes.name: xxPath
attributes.description: "Time function" (piecewise linear) for xx direction. Sequence of couples of numbers. First number is time, second number desired value of respective quantity (stress or strain). The last couple is considered as final state (equal to (nSteps, goal)), other values are relative to this state. Example: nSteps=1000, goal[0]=300, xxPath=((2,3),(4,1),(5,2)) at step 400 (=5*1000/2) the value is 450 (=3*300/2), at step 800 (=4*1000/5) the value is 150 (=1*300/2), at step 1000 (=5*1000/5=nSteps) the value is 300 (=2*300/2=goal[0]). See example :ysrc:`scripts/test/peri3dController_example1` for illusration.

attributes.description: Maximal asolute value of strain allowed in the simulation. If reached, the simulation is considered as finished

attributes.name: youngEstimation

attributes.name: poissonEstimation

attributes.name: lenPs

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.
